assumptions: The trees cover the same taxon set.
limits: Robinson-Foulds counts clade differences; it does not weigh them by branch length or support.
Two methods disagreeing is a result about the data, so the distance and the consensus are reported together.
bio.jane/contract.question: How far apart are these trees over the same taxa, and what topology do they share?

description: Compare trees over the same taxa: the Robinson-Foulds distance between two of them, and the consensus of any number. Two methods disagreeing is a result about the data, so the distance and the shared topology are reported together.

_files.description: The project: record references shaped like _subject. Their records become library documents a tool names in sequences/parts/document; a trace or alignment is found by file name.

_subject.description: The record to act on: exactly one of sequence, accession (+source), sample (an id from list_samples) or file ({name, text} or {name, base64}); record_index picks one record of several.

cutoff.description: the fraction of trees a clade must appear in for a majority consensus. Only applies when mode is majority.

mode.description: how strict the consensus is: strict keeps only clades in EVERY tree; majority keeps those above the cutoff. Values: majority (Majority-rule), strict (Strict).

sharedTaxaOnly.description: prune every tree to the taxa they ALL share before comparing, instead of refusing a mismatch. The numbers then describe the pruned trees, and pruning can only remove or merge splits, so the distance is a lower bound on the disagreement between the trees as given.

trees.description: two or more trees in Newick (NEXUS, PhyloXML and NeXML pastes are sniffed too) — wire `newick` outputs here.

name: compare_trees

comparedTaxa.description: how many taxa the distances were computed over — under `sharedTaxaOnly` this is the shared set, which is smaller than either tree

distances.description: every distance the comparison computes, not just RF

normalized.description: the same distance as a fraction of its maximum, 0 = identical topology, 1 = share nothing

prunedTaxa.description: under `sharedTaxaOnly`: the labels dropped from each tree, so a comparison over a smaller set can never be read as one over the whole

rf.description: Robinson-Foulds distance between the first two trees (absent for one tree)

treeCount.description: how many trees went into the consensus
